title: Michael Johnson vanishes with no records

tellings.quote: said yeah I agree with that that was the last time I ever saw him

plain: In 1977 in Rapid City, South Dakota, an Air Force man named Michael Johnson is said to have vanished from the life of his partner, leaving no records behind. The partner, Mario Woods, a former nuclear missile guard who says the two were abducted together, tells Michels that after one last brief exchange, "that was the last time I ever saw him." To Woods, the lack of any paperwork suggests Johnson was deliberately removed.
